about: The recipe of the demo's made-up prices (machine/agent/noise.py walk_m1): one 1-minute bar every weekday minute 2016-2023, each minute's move drawn at random (0.019% - about $0.25 at $1,300), so no minute says anything about the next one. About 3 million bars, made in about a second from this recipe instead of a 100 MB file. There is NO edge to find: the honest answer for any idea on these prices is 'chance'.
